details:
ORBITAL HEALTH is a conceptual astronaut health monitoring system designed to help track and organize important health indicators during space missions.

Spaceflight can affect the human body through microgravity, isolation, and other environmental conditions. Monitoring astronaut wellness is therefore important for supporting crew safety and mission success.

Our proposed system provides a simple dashboard to display important health indicators such as heart rate, sleep duration, and blood oxygen saturation. It aims to organize health information in one place, highlight unusual readings based on configured thresholds, and support timely review by crew members and medical professionals.

The long-term vision is to integrate wearable health sensors, data visualization, and intelligent monitoring features to support astronaut wellness during long-duration space missions.

ORBITAL HEALTH is currently a conceptual prototype and uses fictional demonstration data. It is not a medically validated system and does not replace professional medical assessment.
